name: Formitable
desc: Restaurant reservation and guest management platform

triggers.name: formitable_booking_created
triggers.description: Triggers when a new booking is created.

triggers.name: formitable_booking_accepted
triggers.description: Triggers when a booking is accepted.

triggers.name: formitable_booking_changed
triggers.description: Triggers when a booking is updated.

triggers.name: formitable_booking_checkin
triggers.description: Triggers when a guest checks in at the restaurant.

triggers.name: formitable_booking_checkout
triggers.description: Triggers when a guest checks out from the restaurant.

triggers.name: formitable_booking_canceled
triggers.description: Triggers when a booking is canceled.

triggers.name: formitable_option_created
triggers.description: Triggers when a booking option is created.

triggers.name: formitable_option_accepted
triggers.description: Triggers when a booking option is accepted. A booking.accepted event will also be fired.

triggers.name: formitable_option_canceled
triggers.description: Triggers when a booking option is canceled.

triggers.name: formitable_option_expired
triggers.description: Triggers when a booking option expires.

triggers.name: formitable_order_ordered
triggers.description: Triggers when a takeaway order is made or a gift voucher is purchased.

triggers.name: formitable_message_sent
triggers.description: Triggers when a message is sent by the customer.

triggers.name: formitable_message_received
triggers.description: Triggers when a message is sent by the restaurant to the customer.

triggers.name: formitable_review_created
triggers.description: Triggers when a review is created.

triggers.name: formitable_review_request
triggers.description: Triggers when a review request can be sent to the customer (typically 1 day after reservation).
